text:
julian: Hey team, running into repeated 504s when pulling an audit-log export for acct acme-corp, timeframe 2025-09-01..2025-09-30. Customer needs ISO27001 evidence bundle. Export fails ~60s in. Billing also shows weird spike in export job charge. Any ideas?
anya: Can you paste the curl you used and response headers? Also which auth method — API key or SAML?
julian: Using SAML assertion (Okta). Repro:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <SAML-JWT>" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/export?from=2025-09-01&to=2025-09-30" -o export.tar.gz
```
Response: 504 Gateway Timeout, headers: `x-request-id: rwd-9821`, `x-runtime: 60.04s`, body: `{ "error": "export_timeout" }`
Also noticed invoice #INV-2025-455 shows a 20% jump tied to export jobs same day.
rami: I see export job 9821 in logs — backend tried to fetch KMS-decrypted keys from HSM and blocked on `HSM:sign` for ~45s, then retry, then timeout. Likely our HSM client hit connection pool exhaustion. Can you share number of concurrent export requests from that account?
julian: Only one concurrent request from the customer. We do have scheduled backup running at same time for another tenant.
tia: For ISO mapping: this export + retention question maps to A.12.4.1 (event logging), A.8.2.3 (disposal), and A.10.1.2 (cryptographic controls). We'll need: 1) Export manifest proving records exported (hashes), 2) KMS key rotation logs, 3) retention policy doc showing retention period, 4) chain-of-custody note describing transfer to customer. Can eng produce manifest + signed hash?
rami: We can add signed manifest if we complete export. Short-term fix: increase export job timeout to 180s and add exponential backoff on HSM calls; longer term: switch to async chunked export so uploads don't hold HSM lock. I'll open infra ticket and a canary patch.
julian: Can you also confirm whether HSM operations are counted as access events for ISO evidence? Customer wants proof KMS keys were used, not exported.
tia: Yes, HSM key usage logs are valid audit evidence. We need concatenated logs covering key id, operation, timestamp, and operator (service account). I'll list exact queries we need.
anya: Can you grab the error trace from `rwd-9821` and paste sanitized stack? That helps repro.
rami: Pasting sanitized trace:
```
[2025-09-30T12:10:22Z] export-job[9821] - start
[2025-09-30T12:10:23Z] hsm-client - request sign key:kms-03a - wait 0.4s
[2025-09-30T12:10:35Z] hsm-client - retry 1 - connection timed out
[2025-09-30T12:10:57Z] export-job - abort, upstream timeout
```
ops-bot: export job 9821 status changed -> FAILED (504) by system
julian: Customer needs a formal note for ISO auditor describing root cause and mitigation. Can we get a draft statement?
tia: I'll draft the auditor note once infra confirms changes and we can attach manifest + hsm logs. Draft ETA EOD.
anya: For immediate help: julian, as a workaround can you ask customer to run exports during 00:00-03:00 UTC when HSM usage is low? :eyes: 
julian: Will propose that. Thanks all :thumbsup:
